en.answer: In the given scenario, you can activate the effect of the <<9491>> that was drawn due to <<9455>>'s effect, and can Special Summon it from your hand.
en.question: I have previously resolved <<9455>> this turn. When my opponent Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster, the card drawn due to <<9455>>'s effect is <<9491>>. Can I now activate <<9491>>'s effect that Special Summons it from my hand?
en.title: If the card drawn by <<9455>>'s effect is <<9491>>, can its effect be activated in response to that Special Summon?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<9455>>」の効果でドローした「<<9491>>」の効果を発動し、手札から「<<9491>>」を特殊召喚する事ができます。
